resources.string: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
A screen lock must be set up on this device
The key that protected the seed no longer works (the device keystore was lost or reset). The wallet and its payments are kept: enter the 12 words to protect it again with a new key.
The wallet requires Android 6 or newer
Pair with my node (QR or file)
Settings → Node (X-39 via tunnel or your own)
Self-custody: the seed lives only on this device, encrypted with its key. Every signature asks for your authentication.
no node: choose one in Settings → Node
⚠ the node is on another network: %1$s
⚠ wrong certificate fingerprint: not talking to that server
⚠ Restored without a full scan: sending is disabled until you sync with your server
waiting for the network to confirm the original or its replacement
Which node does your wallet sync with? The app only speaks Electrum: whatever runs on top of your node is none of its business.
There is no X-39 node for %1$s: only your own server will do.
Node HEALTHY · server %1$s · network %2$s · height %3$s · protocol %4$s · %5$s ms
· certificate validated by a recognised authority
REJECTED: that server is on another network (%1$s). Nothing has changed.
REJECTED: the certificate is not the pinned one (%1$s). Nothing has changed.
The X-39 Electrum server, only through the app\'s X39 Tunnel. Nothing to type. If the tunnel is not active, the wallet does not connect by any other route.
X-39 node in use and healthy: the wallet syncs with it
X-39 node in use. Right now: %1$s

Your Electrum server (electrs or Fulcrum on top of your node): tcp://host:port, ssl://host:port or tcp://xxxx.onion:port. With tcp:// it is unencrypted: only on your local network or through your tunnel. Before using it, the app checks that it responds and that it belongs to your wallet\'s network.
SPKI SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex); filled in when testing

An .onion server is reachable only through Orbot\'s SOCKS5 proxy (by default 127.0.0.1:9050). Without the proxy it does not connect. The proxy is written as an IP address, not a name: that way this device resolves nothing over DNS and the proxy resolves the server name.
For signet testing you may use a third-party PUBLIC server (it sees what you query and who you are). Your own node is the proper choice.
Use a public signet server (third party)
⚠ tcp:// unencrypted: only on your local network or through your tunnel
⚠ an .onion requires the SOCKS5 proxy: tick the box
Certificate fingerprint read: %1$s…%2$s. Compare it with the one your node gives you.
Node saved. When syncing, the wallet will run the full scan it had pending.
Node saved. The wallet syncs with it when you go back; no rescan needed: the chain is the same.
The network cannot be changed once a wallet exists (%1$s).
The Electrum server you use sees your wallet\'s addresses. With your own node, nobody else sees them.

⚠ Own certificate: the app will trust ONLY that fingerprint, the one of the certificate your server presents when testing the connection (or the one you type here), and NO certificate authority. From then on it will talk only to that certificate. If the server is not yours, someone could impersonate it: compare the fingerprint with the one your node gives you. Without this box, with ssl:// the app trusts the recognised public certificate authorities (the same roots browsers use, bundled in the app) and rejects any certificate not signed by one of them, for example a self-signed one.
Network: %1$s (change it in Settings before creating).
⚠ No node set: you can create the wallet, but not sync until you choose one in Settings → Node.
Copy them by hand, in order, somewhere safe. They are shown ONCE: if you leave this screen they disappear. Without them there is no way to recover the funds. They cannot be copied to the clipboard.
I have copied the 12 words by hand
Confirm that you have copied the words

Type the 12 words separated by spaces. Pasting from the clipboard is not possible. After restoring, a full scan with your server is needed before you can send: whatever the server shows comes back as movements, but earlier signed or uncertain payments are not recovered from the seed.
Wallet restored; set up the server and sync: it will run the full scan

The wallet and its payments are kept. Type the 12 words of THIS wallet: the engine checks that they match (without signing anything) and only then a new key is created and the seed is encrypted again. If they do not match or you cancel, everything stays as it was.
Those words are not this wallet\'s; nothing has changed
Seed protected with a new key
Without camera permission scanning is not possible; import the package as a file

The package is generated by your node (herramientas/nodo/emparejar.sh) and carries public data only: network, Electrum server, its certificate fingerprint, name and expiry (24 h at most); optionally the public tunnel data. It is validated in full before touching anything and saved ONLY if the node responds healthy.
The own tunnel is not available yet in this version: the data is saved for when it is. Meanwhile, the node must be reachable directly or through the device VPN («external» mode in Settings).
Confirm: test the node and save only if healthy
Network: %1$s · the review expires in %2$s s
When signing, the engine checks again that what it signs is exactly this.
The coins are now reserved in this wallet. Broadcasting…
⚠ %1$s. The transaction is still signed: you can retry from the main screen or the history.
None (what was signed or uncertain on another installation is not recovered from the seed; what the server shows comes back below as movements)
sat/vB of the replacement (more than the original: %1$s)
Another transaction is built that spends the SAME coins and returns them to an own address, with a higher fee. The network will confirm one of the two.
Replaces %1$s…\nEverything to an own address: %2$s\nAmount %3$s · fee %4$s (%5$s sat/vB)
A new address is given each time; the previous ones remain valid.
Point at the QR generated on your node. What is read is validated on the previous screen; nothing is saved until you confirm.
